title: Mutate in Place
goal: Increment a counter field inside a method without losing ownership.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Methods and Traits

hints: Mutating a struct requires exclusive access to self.
Fields must be explicitly prefixed with self, and Rust has no ++ operator.
explanation: `&mut self` provides exclusive mutable access to the struct, allowing fields to be updated in place. `&self` fails with error `E0596` because shared references are read-only. `self` takes ownership, causing error `E0382` on subsequent uses of the counter. Inside the body, Rust requires `self.` to access fields and does not support `++`.
